title: Hardening FastAPI Services: JWT Authentication and Rate Limiting
body:
Home > APIs
# Hardening FastAPI Services: JWT Authentication and Rate Limiting In modern API development, securing backend endpoints is paramount. Using FastAPI with Python, we can implement robust OAuth2 bearer token authentication with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). We demonstrate password hashing using passlib and Bcrypt, token expiration validation, and middleware for sliding window rate limiting. Protecting against credential stuffing and brute-force attacks requires careful HTTP status code handling and CORS configuration.
Tags: python, fastapi, security

title: Building Scalable Feature Stores with Python and Apache Spark
body:
Feature Store Architecture for Machine Learning

Managing feature parity between offline training and online inference is a classic challenge in machine learning pipelines. In this guide, we use Python alongside Apache Spark and Delta Lake to compute time-travel aggregations, batch feature vectors, and stream real-time events. We will write reproducible ETL jobs that register schema definitions and publish feature snapshots for model training.

title: Quantization and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for LLM Inference Speed
body:
## Optimizing Transformer Inference Latency
            Deploying large language models (LLMs) requires minimizing memory footprint and latency. We explore 4-bit and 8-bit post-training quantization (AWQ and bitsandbytes) for transformer decoders.
            Using PyTorch and Hugging Face, we show how low-rank adaptation reduces parameter count during fine-tuning while KV-cache compression improves tokens-per-second throughput on single GPUs.
            Benchmarking shows a 3.4x speedup with minimal degradation on text generation benchmarks.

title: Designing Multi-Region Active-Active Architectures on AWS with Kubernetes
body:
Multi-Region Distributed Systems

High availability at global scale demands multi-region deployment strategies. We examine Route 53 latency-based routing, Amazon EKS multi-cluster orchestration, and Terraform modules for declarative infrastructure. Key trade-offs include cross-region database replication lag, eventual consistency vs ACID guarantees, and automated failover runbooks during regional cloud outages.

title: PostgreSQL Query Optimization: Index Scans, Partitioning, and Explain Plans
body:
Analyzing slow queries in PostgreSQL begins with EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS). We walk through diagnosing sequential scans, index bloat, and vacuuming deficits.
            We cover B-tree vs BRIN indexes for time-series data, declarative table partitioning, and configuring work_mem and shared_buffers for high-throughput transactional database workloads.

title: Mastering React Server Components and Core Web Vitals
body:
Web
React Server Components (RSC) fundamentally shift how frontend web applications render UI. By rendering data-heavy components on the server, client JavaScript bundle size drops drastically. We measure Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) before and after streaming SSR with Suspense boundaries. Code splitting and CSS-in-JS trade-offs are evaluated for enterprise frontend codebases.

title: Adversarial Machine Learning: Defending Against Data Poisoning and Model Inversion
body:
Adversarial Machine Learning: Defending Against Data Poisoning and Model Inversion

Machine learning models in production are susceptible to adversarial evasion attacks and data poisoning. We explore defense mechanisms including input sanitization, differential privacy, and robust adversarial training.

In this article we step through practical implementation details, code samples, and real-world deployment challenges.

title: Hardening FastAPI Services: JWT Authentication and Rate Limiting (Updated 2026)
body:
Home
# Hardening FastAPI Services: JWT Authentication and Rate Limiting (Updated 2026) In modern API development, securing backend endpoints is paramount. Using FastAPI with Python, we can implement robust OAuth2 bearer token authentication with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). We demonstrate password hashing using passlib and Bcrypt, token expiration validation, and middleware for sliding window rate limiting. Protecting against credential stuffing and brute-force attacks requires careful HTTP status code handling and CORS configuration.
